messages.text: What are the most important signaling test capabilities for applications in Automotive?

建議主軸：Automotive signaling test 最重要應先聚焦 **NG eCall / IMS over LTE-5G 的真實網路條件驗證**，其次才擴展到 5G/LTE modem signaling、IMS voice/data、IP/application traffic，以及 NTN 相關場景 [10][17]。
### 推薦先賣
**NG eCall EN 17240:2024 signaling / compliance test**：R&S 與 Qualcomm Technologies 已用 **R&S CMX500** 驗證 **Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF** 的 **Next Generation eCall** functionality；CMX500 搭配 **R&S CMX-KA098** 可在 realistic network conditions 下做 NG eCall testing，測試情境包含 simulating a PSAP，驗證 voice and data transmission，以及 EN 17240:2024 compliance [10]。
**4G/5G packet-switched / IMS emergency-call migration testing**：eCall 自 2018 年起是 EU all new cars mandatory requirement；因 2G/3G circuit-switched networks obsolete，emergency call systems 需要適配 4G/5G packet-switched cellular networks；EN 17240:2024 covers eCall over IMS networks including 4G LTE and 5G NR technologies [17]。
**Automotive modem 的 cellular signaling / network emulation**：CMX500 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 5G NR device testing，涵蓋 LTE、NR FR1、NR FR2，並支援 NSA、SA、FDD、TDD；CMX500 也提供 NR FR1/FR2 signaling、LTE signaling、IMS/audio/POLQA、application test、IP traffic analysis、throughput measurement、BLER、fading、AWGN 與 CSI report [8]。
### 產品與 Option 對接表
| 產品線 | 可接軌的需求 | 知識庫確認的 option / 規格 | 為什麼適合 | 證據 | 缺口 / 報價風險 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 | NG eCall EN 17240:2024 verification for automotive modem | R&S CMX-KA098 software option | 已用於 Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF 的 NG eCall functionality verification；可在 realistic network conditions 下做 NG eCall testing，並 simulating a PSAP，驗證 voice and data transmission 與 EN 17240:2024 compliance | [10] | 知識庫未標示 CMX-KA098 的完整訂購料號、價格或必備硬體配置 |
| R&S CMX500 | 4G/5G cellular signaling and network emulation | LTE、NR FR1、NR FR2；NSA、SA、FDD、TDD；NR FR1/FR2 signaling；LTE signaling | Automotive NG eCall 正在從 2G/3G circuit-switched 轉向 4G/5G packet-switched / IMS networks；CMX500 支援 LTE/NR network emulation and signaling | [8][17] | 知識庫未直接列出所有 automotive TCU、IVI 或 V2X test cases |
| R&S CMX500 | IMS voice/data, audio quality, IP/application behavior | IMS/audio/POLQA、application test、IP traffic analysis、throughput measurement | NG eCall verification 包含 voice and data transmission；CMX500 具備 IMS/audio/POLQA、application test 與 IP traffic analysis capability | [8][10] | 知識庫未提供 EN 17240:2024 的逐項 test case list |
| R&S CMX500 | Radio-link robustness under signaling | Fading、AWGN、BLER、CSI report、throughput measurement | CMX500 提供 fading、AWGN、BLER、CSI report 與 throughput measurement，可支援 device testing 的 radio-link and performance validation | [8] | 知識庫未直接說明這些項目已用於特定 automotive certification |
| R&S SMW | NTN channel emulation for automotive-related NTN interest | Support for long path delays、enhanced Doppler capabilities、customized dynamic fading | RAW 來源指出 5G NTN-NR gaining interest from chipset/device manufacturers, automotive and satellite/space industry，且 SMW 有 channel emulation capabilities to support NTN testing | [25] | 這是 channel emulation capability，不是知識庫中已確認的完整 automotive signaling conformance solution |
### 限制
知識庫中，直接把 **automotive application** 與 **signaling test** 連在一起的最強證據是 **NG eCall over CMX500 / CMX-KA098** [10]。
Wi‑Fi 7 passages support CMX500 Wi‑Fi 7 signaling R&D tests, but passages do not directly connect Wi‑Fi 7 testing to automotive applications, so it should not be presented as a primary automotive signaling capability from this evidence set [14]。
AREG800A 是 automotive radar echo generator，來源描述的是 radar echo generation，不是 cellular/IMS signaling test capability [3][4]。

[4] Wiki：R&S AREG800A（來源：`AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900.md`）
[8] Wiki：R&S CMX500（來源：`CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32.md`、`CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100.md`）
[10] Wiki：NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification（來源：`Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard.md`、`cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing.md`）
